scripts.build-native: node -e "process.platform === 'win32' ? require('child_process').execSync('npm run build-native:win', {stdio: 'inherit'}) : require('child_process').execSync('npm run build-native:mac', {stdio: 'inherit'})"
scripts.build-native:mac: clang -O2 native/InputHookWorker_mac.c -framework ApplicationServices -framework CoreGraphics -framework Foundation -o native/InputHookWorker_mac
